sn12.70:2.1: This Susīma appears only here, but we meet some deities of the same name ([sn2.29](), [sn11.2]()).
sn12.70:5.1: Susīma misunderstands that these things are intrinsic to enlightenment. The attainments listed here are all regarded as higher powers that can be realized through the practice of meditation. Although they can be helpful in some cases, they are not required for awakening.
